verdict.rationale: Keycloak docs show a clear local sandbox path (docker start-dev mode, isolated realms, realm import/export as JSON) that a user could spin up separately from production, but a hands-on community report explicitly states there is 'no easy supported way to test some changes before production' because configuration lives in the database rather than files, directly contradicting the ease-of-sandbox-testing claim. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-native testing workflow, first-party guidance on safely mirroring/test-copying production data, and resolution of the community-reported testing gap.
